name: On the Scent
summary: Sphinx — the estate brain. Rolls the same fusion Nemesis scores per asset up to the whole estate: a posture board across every Hound (KEV, crown jewels, certs, EOL/crypto, identity, attack paths, AI, IoT, ownership coverage, compliance, SLA, WAS), a blind-spots panel (the unknown-unknowns — assets with no Hound signal, uncredentialed, unclassified, unowned), the cross-Hound surprises no single agent sees (crown jewels unowned/blind, KEV+exposed, EOL on a crown jewel), and a hand-off to Nemesis to act.
